name: mordenkainen
lore:
To encounter the Archmage Mordenkainen is to stand before the cold, calculating eye of the Multiverse itself. He inhabits no mere lair, but shifts between the Obsidian Citadel of Oerth and the shimmering currents of the Astral Sea. His "ecology" is one of pure intellect; he sustains himself on the acquisition of forbidden lore and the preservation of the Great Balance.

Behaviorally, Mordenkainen acts as a cosmic gardener, pruning the overgrowth of both Good and Evil with ruthless impartiality. He is neither savior nor villain, but a master of equilibrium who views reality as a grand equation. Do not mistake his neutrality for mercy; he is notoriously arrogant and views lesser beings as mere pawns on a planar chessboard. Approach with extreme caution: he does not suffer fools, and his loyalty lies solely with the precarious survival of the cosmos.
